description: Three outlets (journal press office, university newsroom, trade magazine) all covering the same peer-reviewed study, each declaring the same upstream DOI. Acceptance test: a shared upstream DOI/policy document forms ONE lineage family (one stream), with the upstream identifier as origin candidate.

sources.title: Study reports thousand-hour perovskite cell stability milestone
sources.lead: A new study reports a perovskite solar cell that retained 94 percent efficiency after one thousand hours of damp-heat testing.

sources.title: Campus team hits durability record for next-generation solar cells
sources.lead: University researchers announced a durability record for next-generation solar cells following extended environmental chamber testing.

sources.title: Commercialization prospects brighten after stability breakthrough
sources.lead: Industry executives said commercialization prospects for tandem modules improved after laboratories demonstrated longer operational lifetimes.
